user.title: ThermoWorks ThermaConnect
user.description: Point your ThermoWorks NODE/Signals/RFX devices at this MQTT broker (via BLE provisioning), then list their serials. Leave the serial list empty to auto-discover any device that publishes on /devices/+.

data.auto_discover: Auto-discover devices seen on the broker

data_description.device_ids: Bootstrap serials so entities exist before the first message. Auto-discovery covers the rest.
data_description.auto_discover: Create a device automatically whenever a new /devices/<id>/... topic appears.
data_description.topic_prefix: Must match the prefix your devices publish to (firmware default: /devices).

abort.mqtt_required: Set up the MQTT integration first — ThermaConnect receives data through it.
abort.already_configured: ThermaConnect is already configured. Use Options to edit devices.

error.invalid_serial: One or more serials are invalid. Expected format: T followed by 12 hex characters (e.g. T10061CE92E24).
